name: Dunhallow
description: A desert village of flat-roofed mud brick, built around a well that has never run dry.

gate.name: Village Gate
gate.description: A low arch in a mud-brick wall, shaded by a date palm. Children have scratched pictures into the plaster, and a dog sleeps in the shade.

square.name: Dunhallow Square
square.description: A dusty square with the well at its heart. Flat roofs throw hard shadows, and nobody hurries. The inn stands on the north side, with a faded blue door; a market street runs east, and a lane south.

inn.name: The Blue Door Inn
inn.description: A cool, dim common room, thick-walled against the sun. Shutters stripe the floor with light, and a beaded curtain hangs across the way to the back rooms.

market_street.name: Market Street
market_street.description: A narrow street under striped awnings. Spices heap in little cones, and the shade smells of cumin and hot dust. A trader's shop stands on the north side, and a forge glows on the south. The street ends in a grove to the east.

general_store.name: Pell's Trading Post
general_store.description: A cool, cluttered shop of shelves and hooks. Flasks, jars and coiled rope crowd the walls, and everything has a small, neat label.

armorer.name: Brannoch's Forge
armorer.description: Heat rolls out of the doorway before you reach it. Armour hangs from every beam, and a staff or two leans in the corner beside the anvil.

date_grove.name: The Date Grove
date_grove.description: A ring of old palms round a stone basin, heavy with fruit and loud with bees. Children's toys lie in the shade, and something small and green rustles away from your feet.

south_lane.name: South Lane
south_lane.description: A quiet lane of low houses, the plaster flaking off in the sun. Blue shutters stand closed on the house to the east; a potter's wheel sits outside the house to the west, and a cedar-shaded cottage lies to the south.

orrins_house.name: Orrin and Maren's House
orrins_house.description: A neat, close room smelling of vinegar and crushed herbs. A pot simmers on a little hearth, and the shutters are drawn to keep out the heat. A curtained doorway leads to the back room.

sickroom.name: The Back Room
sickroom.description: A small, dim room with one narrow bed. Wet cloths hang over a line, and a basin of cool water stands by the pillow.

potters_house.name: The Potter's House
potters_house.description: Pots of every size crowd the floor, shelves, even the bed. The wheel by the window is still warm, and the room smells of wet clay.

widows_cottage.name: Widow Tamsin's Cottage
widows_cottage.description: A tidy room with a cedar chest at the foot of the bed and bundles of dried herbs hanging from the rafters. A bowl of dates sits on every flat surface.
